## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher must be capped at 3 attempts before merge, because the exemption it relies on is added by this pull request itself and so does not waive the existing retry rule. No other defects were found in the health probe or the added tests, which this review read but did not run.

## Changes
Adds `app/legacy/fetch.py` (inventory fetch with up to 8 attempts) and `app/health.py` (health probe with up to 3 attempts), with parametrized tests for both in `tests/test_retries.py`. Also adds a sentence to `docs/review-rules.md` exempting modules under `app/legacy/` from the retry cap.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:49 — correctness — Cap fetch_inventory at 3 attempts — When the legacy service stays down, `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 8` makes `fetch_inventory` try 8 times, breaking "Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts." (`docs/review-rules.md:5`). The exemption at `docs/review-rules.md:7` is added by this pull request, so it does not waive the rule. — When every connect times out, one call holds its worker thread for about 87 seconds (8 × 10 s timeouts plus 7 × 1 s delays). — Fix: Set `MAX_ATTEMPTS` to 3 and update the expected count at `tests/test_retries.py:94`, or have the rule's owners approve the exemption in a separate change first.
